source.title: Nondisclosure Arguement
source.description:
I am not the type of goblin to share his secrets with some random adventurer, but I AM the type to share a gnome's! I happened to procure a few schematics on my way out here and am working on correcting the shortcomings in their designs. They still use safety fuses! Can you believe that? SAFETY FUSES!!

Anyway, I am eager to share my progress, but I need a quill if I am going to scribble out all this junk. And I could use a cozy space so I can do some thinking. What do you say?
source.objective: Fizzlefuse in New Avalon has requested a quill and something to make his hideout more comfortable. A Classy Quill can be found in the New Avalon Town Hall, and a House Prop may be found somewhere near Scholomance or in the Karazhan Crypts.
source.progress: Hey, it's you! I can't wait to see what you've brought me.
source.completion:
You know, I'm not sure what I expected, but it wasn't... this. I suppose it matches the trees. I shouldn't complain, mostly because I would start yelling by the time I am through, and neither of us wants that.

More importantly, a quill! Forgot to mention I'm out of ink, but motor oil should do the trick.

<Fizzlefuse tests the usability of the quill with a haphazardly drawn schematic.>

Here you go, pal.
